upstream.contract: Side-chat tab wraps the same chat panel in bg-background; the main chat also uses bg-background.

defect: The pane corner had the expected content color while auto-filled child scroll bodies painted the application Window blue. Grabbing only the pane could hide some inherited host-background differences.

correction.source: SideChatPane::setUiScale (called after theme refresh) maps Window brushes to current application Base for active/inactive/disabled palettes and makes QScrollArea container/viewport/body layers transparent, as already used in ConversationView.
correction.scope: Background-only; no control sizing, queue/question lifecycle, routing or provider changes.
correction.intermediateEvidence: audit/side-chat-background/full-after.txt demonstrates palette-only change was insufficient: 15 passed,1 failed until scroll-body auto-fill was removed.

regression.assertions: Positive blank interior pixels from whole MainWindow render: header action margin, transcript viewport, outer controls viewport and nested question body; light→dark→light at1100 and350 pixel widths. Existing visibility, answer/control behavior, queue and isolation assertions retained.

limits: Offscreen Qt renders on this Windows/Qt6.11.2 setup; no universal DPI/platform/pixel-perfect parity claim.
Representative positive background samples plus visual inspection, not exhaustive per-pixel reference image equivalence.
Aggregate all-target integration and final executable deployment inspection are tracked separately.
sourceHashEncoding: SHA-256 of source bytes with CRLF normalized to LF; no other byte changes.
